slice: P6-D DXF CLASS metadata refusal for AC1009

sourceEvidence.repositoryVersionGate: dxfRW::write emits the CLASSES section only when the target revision is newer than AC1009.
sourceEvidence.repositoryDefect: Caller-supplied DRW_Class metadata passed preflight but the AC1009 writer omitted the CLASSES section and returned success, silently losing the supplied records.

implementation.change: dxfRW::write now refuses AC1009 when its caller-supplied CLASS list is nonempty, reports dxf-class-target-version and BAD_VERSION, and leaves the destination untouched. Empty CLASS input is unchanged. The generated test retries the same codec at AC1027 and verifies fresh typed CLASS readback.

focusedTest.coverage: For ASCII and Binary, a custom CLASS record at AC1009 returns BAD_VERSION with the expected diagnostic and preserves a destination sentinel; the same codec then writes AC1027 successfully and typed readback observes one class.

limits: Generated caller-supplied CLASS metadata only; no custom OBJECTS instance, producer-authored DWG/DXF, or native application behavior is qualified.
This closes one AC1009 CLASSES omission and does not cover unrelated downgrade loss or other class profiles.
